sources.entry: Freepbx - Web-based open source GUI that controls and manages Asterisk. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.name: FreePBX
summary.one_liner: FreePBX is an open-source, web-based graphical interface for managing the Asterisk IP PBX phone system.
use_cases: Building a custom office phone system
Managing an Asterisk PBX through a web browser
Configuring SIP telephony extensions and trunks
Extending phone system features with modules
summary.what_it_does: FreePBX is an open-source web-based graphical user interface that manages and controls Asterisk, an IP PBX engine. The page describes it as a tool for building a phone system tailored to user needs, through configurable modules. It has a version 17 installer for Debian 12, according to the page. Development uses separate GitHub repositories for issue tracking, security reporting, the installer, and modules. The project was first released in 2004.
notable: Web GUI that manages the Asterisk IP PBX engine
Modular design with many open source modules for configuration
First released in 2004; GPL-2.0 licensed per awesome-selfhosted listing
caveats: Page text does not describe specific features or setup steps beyond the Debian 12 installer mention
